profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roblox
profile.summary: I have 6 years of experience in software engineering. I've focused mainly on building and maintaining data pipelines as well as developing back-end services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ads Platform Team
- Trained agentic (GPT) models and fine-tuned VLMs (qwen-vl) using SFT & LoRA to moderate 10000+ video and image ads per day, automating the human moderation flow and reducing cost by 90+% with Temporal workers
--- Implemented 5+ skills to fully automate an agentic moderation flow to validate performance against human labels
--- Scaled the local skill run to dispatch tasks across remote workspaces to handle 5000+ ad evaluations daily
--- Created an agent to scrape Meta ads through a browser flow to pass back to moderation agents for review
- Drove the entire Google mobile and desktop ads reporting pipeline design, implementations, and coordination using Airflow DAGs amp; Apache Flink to support offline and real-time reporting and revenue share for Rewarded Ads, processing 350M+ rows of data across 11 Data Transfer files (requests, impressions, etc) joined with revenue data
- Created a "golden" dataset using DAGs that process 30B+ serving response and 1B+ impression events daily to join into a singular source of truth for all ad analytical purposes, including model training for better ad delivery
- Processed 60M+ Kafka events daily in Flink and DAGs to upload reporting metrics for 4000+ ad units in 2000+ games
- Oversaw the team's data pipeline projects to suggest designs/improvements for new features impacting ad reporting
- Coordinated cross-team collaboration to migrate 120+ pipelines to newer infrastructure and technologies
- Optimized up to 70% on resource usage on the heaviest pipelines, reducing monetary costs by 50%
- Mentored 5+ engineers to onboard onto the ads reporting data pipeline to expand team expertise in this domain

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Ads Team
- Spearheaded SSP ads reporting to support revenue share to developers showing third-party ads in their games
- Owned Audience Estimation with Airflow DAGs to show advertisers potential reach based on targeting criteria, processing 1B+ serving requests daily to bucket users, then approximate cardinality using HyperLogLog sketches
- Designed modular data sanity checks to improve ads reporting accuracy, preventing bad data from surfacing to users
- Coded an ads moderation tool using React to evaluate immersive ad image creatives, with features including zooming, reshaping, recoloring, and in-game billboard models features to maximize moderator context for accuracy
- Implemented a full-stack solution (React, Golang) for an ads debugging tool used by all ads teams daily to track ads serving and delivery performance and anomalies, reporting current delivery status and metrics
- Pioneered Ads Serving API, integrating with a 3rd-party ad manager and weighting ads to determine ads ranking while respecting user targeting dimensions and frequency capping to serve new immersive 3D display/portal ads

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Social Connection Team
- Owned the User Blocking service serving 80K+ QPS and migrated 30+ consumers to the new C# gRPC microservice
- Migrated 116M+ user blocking lists from MSSQL to CockroachDB while anonymizing user IDs to comply with GDPR
- Implemented friending API endpoints to support friend requests from imported contacts

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Social Connection Team
- Developed the full moderation flow for Display Names with CSHTML, handling data changes with MSSQL
- Integrated an SNS topic amp; SQS processor to reliably remove all user connections upon a user block

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher (Ray Tune)
positions.description:
- Designed and coded a sklearn GridSearchCV API combining Tune schedulers for 10x faster parameter search
- Published a Medium blog post featuring the new library
- Integrated and modified the Dragonfly API to add scalable Bayesian optimization techniques within Ray
- Added a fully-functional example of using population based training to train a memory neural network

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher (Modin)
positions.description:
- Implemented parallelized functions with Ray to speed up JSON reading by over 2x for 200+ MB files
- Tested against newest versions of Pandas (0.25.0) to maintain equivalent functional behavior

positions.title: Back End Engineer Intern (Promoted Inventory Team)
positions.description:
- Implemented and deployed from scratch a referral code service in Java as a Maven project with Spring dependency
injections as part of a quarterly company objective to promote reward programs for users
- Created a secure procedure to generate referral codes via hashing (SHA256) to also avoid user codes from colliding
- Designed database schema and data access objects with JDBI to store & update user referral codes under PostgreSQL
- Integrated Kafka to read in millions of reservation events to track seated reservations and reward users accordingly
- Collaborated with front-end to add support for custom discovery shifts for a 100+% more revenue pricing program
- Coded a CRON job to update 1000+ restaurants’ metrics hourly to ensure restaurants maximize discoverability

positions.title: Lab Assistant/Course Reader for EE16A
positions.description:
- Helped students with circuits and Python code in two weekly lab sessions
- Graded weekly assignments and midterm/final exams

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Designed dashboards using Tableau after analyzing 2500+ rows to identify discrepancies between databases
- Implemented from scratch a payment log with Google Sheets with supplementary scripts in JavaScript and Python for receipt generation, archiving, and daily summary files to process 5000+ yearly transactions
- Developed R scripts to generate printed rosters and documents for 3800+ kids for the recreational sports camps

positions.title: Software Engineering and Data Analytics Intern
positions.description:
- Visualized and analyzed 100,000+ rows using R to determine user habits with the company’s light products
- Developed an algorithm in Python (NumPy, Pandas) using matrices and cross-correlation to suggest schedules and groups based on data for automated light controls
- Communicated and documented in Chinese to minimize the language barrier with the engineers

positions.title: Academic Intern for CS61A/CS61B
positions.description:
- Assisted students individually during weekly lab sections
- Hosted weekly office hours to help students one-on-one

company.name: The Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science

positions.title: Private Tutor
positions.description:
- Tutored a sophomore in Algebra II and high school chemistry
- Created PowerPoint presentations to help review concepts
- Wrote original quizzes to assess the student's understanding
- Boosted the student's grade by half a letter grade in one quarter

positions.title: Member
positions.description:
- Attended weekly morning-to-afternoon co-learning sessions and workshops involving computer architecture and HTML/CSS/Javascript
- Assisted other members in various concepts learned throughout the workshops

honors.title: Hacktech 2019: Best Entertainment Hack
honors.description:
- Developed an entertainment system that converts hand and arm motions to play preset tracks or custom sounds
- Implemented with the Kinect API to recognize hand motions and positions to toggle play modes or instruments
- Wrote tracks using Sonic Pi 
- Designed a UI with PyGame to draw important joints with Kinect
honors.issuer: Issued by Major League Hacking · Mar 2019

- Part of the top third of all computer science majors in UC Berkeley

projects.title: Web Development Tutorials
projects.description:
- Co-authored a series of web development tutorials to teach members of the committee basic skills
- Tutorials include guides on Git, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript

projects.title: Hermes
projects.description:
- Implemented a web application featuring Flask, JavaScript, jQuery, and HTML/CSS to enhance lectures for more
immersive learning with a team of 4
- Designed both the front and back-end structure of bite-sized exercises to be inserted in lectures
- Integrated into Berkeley’s introductory CS course (CS 61A) for beta-testing
